issues.description: Field 'name' in class Ride has a visibility mismatch: the UML in the problem statement declares the attribute as private (UML shows '-name: String'), while the solution implementation declares it as public ('public String name;'). This contradicts the exercise instruction to provide public getters for all attributes and may confuse students about intended encapsulation.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the declaration of the 'name' field in Ride.java from public to private (private String name;), and rely on the existing public getter getName(). This aligns the implementation with the UML's private attribute notation and the exercise instructions.
